MemeDef.label: body way
MemeDef.description: The body is the first temple. Temper it with blows, hunger and cold until it no longer needs the qi to be a weapon.

rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->body
memeHyphenPrefix->body
memeConcept->body way
memeLeaderNoun->monk
creation(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->[deity0_name] taught the body way.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->[deity0_name] showed the first [memberName] the body way.
intro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->The early [memberNamePlural] of the [place_summary] [place_name] built a great [altarName] to [deity0_name].
conflict(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->A powerful [foeLeader] despised the [memberNamePlural] and their ways.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->[memberName]'s savior [founderName] came down from the mountain with nothing but the body way.
victory(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->[founderName] faced the [foeLeader] and the [foeSoldiers] fled.
setup(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->The believers were scattered, so they gathered to follow the body way.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->The believers spread out and grew in number, each walking the body way in their own way.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->Disciple, the old masters used to say:
lesson(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->the body is the first temple. Temper it with blows, hunger and cold until it no longer needs the qi to be a weapon.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->You will understand it after many years of practice.
archistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->The archotechs watch the body way as a gardener watches a vine.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart, and those who followed the body way will remain.
animistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_BodyWay)->The spirits of the land walk the body way with us.
